ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

Posts.helper: Add at least one posts item. You can add more items as needed.

PostTitle.placeholder: Keep it short & catchy, if you can!
PostTitle.helper: Enter the post title to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

MonthName.helper: Choose the month name from the available options.

MonthDay.helper: Must be a positive number between 1 and 31.

PostUrl.helper: It doesn't need to be a local page.

PostIntro.helper: Should be no more than a short sentence.

Testimonials.helper: Add at least one testimonials item. You can add more items as needed.

TitleCompany.helper: Enter the title company to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

ImageUrl.helper: Doesn't need to be a local file.
